After failing to see Orca Whales on our Vancouver whale watching adventure, I almost immediately booked this trip in lateJuly. When my mom suddenly passed way in August, I thought it would completely damper my spirits, but it looks as though she blessed us with finally seeing these gorgeous animals in the wild. We had to sail into Canadian waters just to see them! We even saw another Humpback Whale, so I guess that makes me the Humpback Whale Whisperer? Anyway, I miss my mom and I wish I could’ve shown her these photos.
